'''Plasma Energy Engineering''' was a company on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. When the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] offered to invest on Naboo, its representatives assured [[King/Legends|King]] [[Bon Tapalo/Legends|Bon Tapalo]] that their partners would work with Naboo firms such as Plasma Energy Engineering and [[Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps/Legends|Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps]] in order to avoid the appearance of foreign occupation.<ref name="DP" />
